verdict.rationale: The enterprise-readiness docs cover SOC2/HIPAA compliance and SSO/RBAC, and self-hosted/BYOC deployment lets customers keep all data under their own infrastructure, which implicitly gives control over retention and deletion. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data retention policy, a deletion API, or configurable retention windows for the managed SaaS offering. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion API or policy documentation, evidence of deletion controls for the hosted (non-BYOC) service, independent confirmation of these controls working in practice.
